verdict.rationale: Cursor documents MCP support to connect to external tools/data sources with a marketplace and OAuth (cursor-docs-15/16/17/21), explicitly lists Slack and Linear integration and Automations triggered by Slack/Linear/GitHub/GitLab events (cursor-docs-6, cursor-docs-25), and Cloud Agents can be kicked off from Slack and Linear per supplementary docs. Jira and Google Drive are not explicitly named, but MCP's open protocol plus marketplace entries make these addable in principle. missing for 10: explicit named Jira and Google Drive connectors/marketplace entries, independent hands-on confirmation of these specific integrations working end-to-end.
